# ScreenDock

> ScreenDock is an AirPlay receiver for Android. It lets a Mac, iPhone or iPad mirror its screen, stream music, or send video to an Android phone, tablet, Android TV or Google TV over Wi-Fi. Free with no ads; an optional one-time "ScreenDock Pro" purchase ($9.99 US) removes the 10-minute session limit. Open source (GPLv3), built on UxPlay. Not affiliated with Apple.

- [Home](https://screendock.cressu.com/): features, setup steps, supported formats, pricing, FAQ
- [Startseite (Deutsch)](https://screendock.cressu.com/de/): the same page in German
- [Comparison](https://screendock.cressu.com/compare/): ScreenDock vs AirScreen vs Mirroring360 (price, ads, open source, protocols)
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cressu.screendock): install the app
- [Source code](https://github.com/tarek369/screendock): GPLv3 repository
- [Privacy policy](https://screendock.cressu.com/privacy): no data collection; everything stays on the local network

## Key facts
- Senders: macOS, iOS, iPadOS (Screen Mirroring / AirPlay)
- Receivers: Android 7.0+ phones, tablets, Android TV, Google TV
- Video: H.264 and H.265 up to 4K at 60 fps; audio: AAC and Apple Lossless (ALAC)
- DRM-protected apps (Netflix, Disney+, Apple TV app) cannot be mirrored to any third-party receiver
- Touch control back to the Mac is not supported
